description: This file contains shell functions related to preparing and running build, test, and verification gates for a software project, managing dependencies, changelogs, and reusing previous build states.

methods.name: run_prepare_push_retry_gates
methods.description: Coordinates dependencies, build, check, and optional test steps for the project, considering whether only documentation or changelogs changed and potentially reusing previous gate results.

methods.name: prepare_gates
methods.description: Prepares the project environment for a pull request by checking out branches, managing changelog requirements, and running build/test steps depending on file changes, while also managing environment state.
